What the Rock Kept

SPEAKING · SPEECH FUNCTIONS

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The class chart

As you record, the four numbers fill in. Compare the two rain numbers, then the two water numbers.

80 cmRAIN THERE
6 mLWATER HELD HERE
31 mLWATER HELD THERE
WHAT FELLWHAT STAYED

THE SCENE

Your class poured water into 100 mL of dry rock. You measured how much water stayed inside. Water that stays inside rock is called groundwater. A school in another country did the same test. You are alone in the science room with the class chart. You need four numbers, and four people each have one.

THE HISTORY

Your test is part of the GLOBE program. It began in 1995. Students in more than 120 countries take part. They send every number to one shared map.
